editors_post:
Meet the editors of Kabita Live.

Pradeep Biswal · Editor
A poet in Odia and English, a translator and an editor. His writing brings together inward reflection and the world around us.

Paresh Kumar Pattnaik · Managing Editor
An Odia fiction writer whose work spans short stories, novels and books for younger readers.

Two literary journeys, one journal that welcomes Odia, Hindi and English together.

Portraits: existing published photographs interpreted with an AI-assisted paper-and-watercolour treatment. Pradeep Biswal’s source photograph: pradeepbiswal.in. Paresh Kumar Pattnaik’s source photograph: Puri Literature Festival. Design: Ahimanikya Satapathy with AI assistance.

welcome_post:
Welcome to Kabita Live.

ମାଟିର ମହକ · ମନର ସ୍ୱର
The fragrance of earth. The voice of the heart.

A monthly poetry journal with Odia roots and room for many voices — in Odia, Hindi and English. This is a place to meet poets, discover poems and translations, and spend a little more time with words.

Follow Kabita Live for poetry, editor introductions and glimpses into the journal. Share the words that stay with you, keeping the poem’s title and the poet’s name together.

Which language do you reach for when you want to read a poem?

Artwork: “LIFE AS IT IS,” created with AI assistance for Kabita Live. An artistic interpretation of Odisha after rain, not a documentary photograph. Creative direction and design: Ahimanikya Satapathy.

#KabitaLive #OdiaPoetry #HindiPoetry #EnglishPoetry
